definitions.gloss: to acquire, to obtain, to get
definitions.explanation: To officially obtain qualifications, licenses, rights, or data through a formal process.

examples.japanese: {資格|しかく}を{取得|しゅとく}する。
{運転免許|うんてんめんきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}した。
{留学|りゅうがく}するためにビザを{取得|しゅとく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: You need to obtain a visa in order to study abroad.

notes:
{取得|しゅとく}する is composed of {取|しゅ} (take) + {得|とく} (gain, obtain).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{取得|しゅとく}する

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {資格|しかく}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain a qualification
- {免許|めんきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain a license
- {特許|とっきょ}を{取得|しゅとく}する: to obtain a patent
- データを{取得|しゅとく}する: to acquire data

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {取得|しゅとく}する: to acquire (formal, official process)
- {得|え}る: to obtain, to gain (general)
- {取|と}る: to take, to get (everyday, informal)
